gates.title: Repository and source audit
gates.pass_condition: Actual branch/state/instructions and source decisions recorded; existing work preserved.

gates.title: Pins and manifest validation
gates.pass_condition: Reject missing identities, placeholders, invalid budgets, hash drift and ready-without-evidence.

gates.title: Client configuration isolation
gates.pass_condition: Exact local provider and roles; secret failures; external/project discovery tested rather than assumed.

gates.title: Real OMP with scripted HTTP/SSE
gates.pass_condition: Typed streamed tool round trip, fragments, UTF-8 and finish semantics through the actual client.

gates.title: Failure and cancellation semantics
gates.pass_condition: HTTP failures, truncated SSE, disconnects and queue/cancel faults cannot falsely succeed or repeat completed side effects.

gates.title: Lifecycle ownership and edge cases
gates.pass_condition: Idempotency, occupied port, stale PID, download/hash/space/config failures and safe cleanup.

gates.title: Public CI boundary
gates.pass_condition: Hosted least-privilege host-free CI; no untrusted PR access to GPU runners or secrets.

gates.title: Actual host and complete identity
gates.pass_condition: Authorized exclusive GPU, measured headroom, pinned real components and loopback listener.

gates.title: Real stock OMP and Strata tool turns
gates.pass_condition: Three independent typed tool-cycle runs; verifier-confirmed successful fixes; preserve protocol and task-quality failures separately.

gates.title: Observed live prefix reuse
gates.pass_condition: At least three controlled same-session continuations with nonzero engine-observed reuse and correct results.

gates.title: Authentication and no-cloud behavior
gates.pass_condition: Wrong/missing key refused on generation routes; dead endpoint fails; auxiliary routing and test egress controls evidenced.

gates.title: Real fault recovery
gates.pass_condition: Generate/queue cancellation and transport loss; next turn valid; no false completion or duplicate side effects.

gates.title: Engine restart with surviving client
gates.pass_condition: Transcript-based continuation retains required facts/tool results; replay allowed; no state-restore claim.

gates.title: Client and combined restart
gates.pass_condition: Actual intended transcript resumes without re-executing completed tools to reconstruct history.

gates.title: Declared capacity and overflow
gates.pass_condition: Tokenized prompt plus reserved output within actual limit; near-limit tool follow-up; explicit overflow error.

gates.title: OMP compaction continuation
gates.pass_condition: Reduced-threshold actual compaction plus realistic long-session compaction when long-session claims are enabled; facts/tools/routing valid.

gates.title: Session/branch correctness
gates.pass_condition: A-B-A and branch/resume canaries correct; re-prefill allowed; no claim of hostile-tenant isolation.

gates.title: Real lifecycle and preservation
gates.pass_condition: Controlled start/stop/restart/cleanup; unrelated state unchanged or explicitly restored; no orphan workers.

gates.title: Resource and stability record
gates.pass_condition: Measured peak RAM/VRAM/disk, startup and failures; conservative reproducible fit.

gates.title: Optional images
gates.pass_condition: Actual vision artifacts, images/tools/format conversion/context and compaction tested; otherwise capability disabled.

gates.title: Optional remote OMP route
gates.pass_condition: Explicit loopback authenticated tunnel, failure and resume tests; separate from local route.

gates.title: Bounded task evaluation
gates.pass_condition: Six fixed tasks times three scored attempts; independent immutable verifier; all failures/timeouts included.

gates.title: Controlled NInfer comparison
gates.pass_condition: Same-boundary rerun with declared engine/model/hardware differences; no borrowed headline measurements.

gates.title: Documented clean install and claims
gates.pass_condition: Fresh-root quickstart and applicable gate/identity review; clean OS not implied; claims no broader than evidence.
